channel.title: AI & Attention Observatory — Research Discoveries
channel.description: Weekly research indexing on AI and attention. Preliminary bibliographic summaries, not verified systematic reviews.

item.title: Toward Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence for Users’ Digital Well-Being: Systematic Review, Synthesis, and Future Directions
item.description: Literature review synthesizing human-centered AI approaches to digital well-being and future system design.

item.title: How AI-Driven Search May Reshape Democracy, Economics, and Human Agency
item.description: Analytical essay examining AI search interfaces, independent verification and users' control over information discovery.

item.title: Generative AI tool use enhances academic achievement in sustainable education through shared metacognition and cognitive offloading among preservice teachers
item.description: Examines cognitive offloading and metacognition in AI-supported education; attention fragmentation is not a direct reported outcome.

item.title: "It makes you think": Provocations Help Restore Critical Thinking to AI-Assisted Knowledge Work
item.description: Study of 24 participants examining provocations such as critiques and alternatives alongside AI suggestions as supports for reflection.

item.title: The Impact of Generative AI on Critical Thinking: Self-Reported Reductions in Cognitive Effort and Confidence Effects From a Survey of Knowledge Workers
item.description: Survey of 319 knowledge workers investigating generative AI and self-reported critical thinking and cognitive effort; does not establish AI-caused attention fragmentation.

item.title: The Battle for Cognitive Liberty in the Age of Corporate AI
item.description: Commentary about cognitive autonomy, AI systems, and the monetization of attention; an argument rather than evidence of measured cognitive effects.
